_comment: Code-scanning alerts dismissed by .github/workflows/code-scanning.yml (contrib/secops/code-scanning-triage.py). One entry per tool + rule + path glob: reason is one of 'false positive', 'won't fix', 'used in tests'; comment is the argument a reviewer can check (280 characters reach GitHub). A real finding is fixed in code, never listed here.

dismissals.comment: node/devnet jobs run only on workflow_dispatch (write access). 'Resolve the node branch' admits only a branch or tag of the node repo or a SHA the compare API finds on one of its line branches; fork commits are refused. CodeQL matches the output name 'sha'.

The checkout is the node repo (boyfromcave/ycash-dd or ycash6) at a ref 'Resolve the node branch' admits: its own branch or tag, or a SHA on one of its line branches (compare API). No PR head or fork commit. Dispatch only, write access. CodeQL matches the name 'sha'.
